name: Dna
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the Creator of all life, forming man uniquely in His own image and likeness, as seen in Genesis 1:26-27. This divine design reflects God's intentional craftsmanship, culminating in the creation of male and female and affirming the goodness of His work (Genesis 1:31). The life of the flesh is intimately connected to the blood, which God has established as the means of atonement for the soul (Leviticus 17:11), underscoring the sacredness of human life as part of His creation.
